title: サマースプリントシリーズ制覇！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The award ceremony comes as suddenly as the competition.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Commendation! You've conquered the Summer Sprint Series!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: In summary! With her trainer's guidance, Curren Chan placed first in…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The Hakodate Sprint Stakes, the Keeneland Cup, and the Centaur Stakes of the Summer Sprint Series!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Shining as the queen of the sprint, she has made this Summer's Sprint tour another exciting one!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid indeed! As the director of Tracen Academy, I both appreciate and applaud your achievements!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That is all! Awards ceremony over! Applause!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So the good thing Director Akikawa mentioned might happen if I won the Summer Sprint Series was an award! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I tried so hard! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And one other thing…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Um… Since we're here, I was just wondering…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Would it be okay if I took a picture with you? And can I have your permission to post it on Umastagram? ♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Granted! Post it wherever you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Director?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay, here we go. Strike a pose! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Freeze!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I think a slightly different angle would look better. Like so…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan continues to lecture the director on how to be popular on social media even after the award ceremony ends. Before I know what's happening…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Okay, that should do it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to work with you more on the "Charms of Tracen Academy, Featuring Curren Chan ♪" project! Can you handle the rest?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Understood! I'll pass on the word to Tazuna!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪ Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll do the very best promotion I can!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …For both our sakes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ambitious as ever, Curren Chan takes up a new project.
